evidence: The thin-film depositions were carried out in a commercial flow-type hot-wall ALD reactor (F-120 by ASM Microchemistry Ltd.) at 300 °C deposition temperature. The reactor pressure was maintained between 3 and 6 mbar and nitrogen ( > 99.999%; Schmidlin UHPN 3000 N2 generator) was used both as the purging and carrier gas. The pulse/purge lengths for the mixed Ln precursor were 1.5s/2s, while for O2 were 2.5s/3s.
